title: Exotic Springy Saudi Arabian Peppers Skewers
description: A pungent and springy Saudi Arabian dish featuring peppers, perfect for a brunch mood, made with mushimono steam and dairy free friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium high heat.
Cut the bell peppers into 1 inch pieces and place them in a bowl.
Add the onion, mushrooms, Saudi Arabian Spice Mix, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, and black pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Thread the pepper mixture onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Steam the skewers using a steamer basket for an additional 5 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Repeat with the remaining ingredients if necessary.
